title: Pass the PhD confirmation seminar successfully & Welcome to 2nd year PhD research!

Receive an Outstanding Presentation award at the QUT School of Information Systems Doctoral Consortium!
Pass the PhD final seminar successfully!

Receive the Best HDR Championship 2025 and HDR Accomplishment Award 2025 from QUT School of Information Systems!
Receive the High Achiever HDR Student Award (December 2025) from QUT Faculty of Science!
Officially completed my PhD at QUT on building adversarially robust predictive systems for tabular data, and can now go by Dr.!

Honoured to speak as the Student Presenter at the QUT graduation ceremony on behalf of the graduating cohort.
